operation_proposals.source_operation: structured biological evidence extraction, evidence-constrained verbalization and description quality control
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper documents extraction of structured molecular fields, construction of an evidence-constrained prompt, GPT-4 verbalization and rule-based quality filtering as a source-defined pipeline without exposing a catalog-supported computation for the complete sequence.

operation_proposals.source_operation: spatial patch extraction, resizing and coordinate registration
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog can represent coordinate alignment and position selection separately, while image resizing is not represented by an exact image-resampling primitive.
The paper names modality-specific encoders and reports their outputs without establishing an internal computation representable by a catalog primitive.

operation_proposals.source_operation: visual resampler or gene Q-Former compression
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper reports fixed virtual-token outputs but does not establish the attention schedule, query interface or projection order sufficiently for a catalog decomposition.

operation_proposals.source_operation: modality-placeholder replacement and multimodal sequence assembly
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper documents replacement of reserved modality spans but does not establish the sequence-update algebra or ordering.
The paper states that the generative backbone decodes responses but does not document the decoder computation or sampling schedule.
The catalog contains no operation for contrastive similarity, negative-pair construction or InfoNCE loss evaluation.
The catalog contains no operation for policy/reference-policy likelihood ratios, advantage weighting or clipped reward-weighted optimization.
The paper identifies downstream heads and their outputs without specifying their internal computation.
The paper documents rule-based extraction and matching without specifying a catalog operation for the parser semantics.
